summary: Iteration 25 (NPC Filter System addendum to Dynamic Locations) fully verified. Backend pytest 12/12 PASS covering response shape (tag_options/attr_options/archetype tags+attrs), Platinum Lounge filter pool (5 Wealthy/Corporate NPCs with social_status>=60, all source=filter), Backstreets manual bypass (bar_regular Drifter still present as source=manual), toggle-tag-persists PUT round-trip, and CREATE/DELETE of a filtered Fitness-only location (returns exactly gym_coach+athlete). Admin editor filter UI verified live: loc-include-filtered toggle rendered, tag-<Tag> chips for all 6 tags, min-social_status=60, loc-filter-weight=1. Player Meet People view (kiri) shows Platinum Lounge encounters exactly matching the /admin filter pool (5 × 20%) and Backstreets shows Shady Contact 70% + Bar Regular 30% with manual bypass — parity between admin preview and engine confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: location_pool() in social_engine.py cleanly separates manual (bypass) from filter sources — good design, aligned with review-request semantics.

_archetype_passes uses `arche.get(attr, 999999) > v` for max_attrs — if an archetype is missing an attribute it will fail max checks (999999 > any max). Currently all archetypes get defaults via seed_data ARCHETYPE_META backfill, but a stricter default (e.g., raise/log) would prevent silent exclusion if new archetypes are added without meta.
Frontend uses purple '*' badge on filter-sourced pills and hyphenated 'Filters: Wealthy/Corporate · min social_status≥60' preview — user-friendly and matches admin editor state.

GET /admin/locations now returns tag_options + attr_options + enriched archetypes — expanding response ~2-3x for the admin panel. Fine for admin-only use, but consider a lightweight variant if this list grows further.
Legacy note from iter_24 still applies: server.py is ~3238 lines; locations + filters section (2140-2310) is ripe for extraction into a dedicated router module.
